Subject: Re: Problem with ldap and recipient with "="

On Fri, Mar 07, 2008 at 09:47:34AM -0300, Reinaldo de Carvalho wrote: > I get one especific error (from possible SPAM): >  > Mar  6 02:48:37 server postfix/smtpd[10152]: NOQUEUE: reject: RCPT > from bogomil.xenologics.com[212.44.160.10]: 451 4.3.5 Server > configuration problem; from=<> to= > proto=ESMTP helo= > 	 > I think ldap_dict is not handling character "=" correctly before ldap > query. "xyjx=okkumef=980e81275@example.br" should get "user unknown". You show no evidence to support this claim. You are not looking at or reporting the log messages that detail the problem. > Postfix 2.3.8 LDAP queries with this address work for me. $ postmap -vq xyjx=okkumef=980e81275@example.br ldap:/tmp/ldap.cf . postmap: dict_ldap_connect: Actual Protocol version used is 2. postmap: dict_ldap_connect: Cached connection handle for LDAP source /tmp/ldap.cf postmap: dict_ldap_lookup: /tmp/ldap.cf: Searching with filter nruqkzsqpdlvreojnruq=kzsq=pdlvreo=957u04124@example.br postmap: dict_ldap_get_values[1]: Search found 0 match(es) postmap: dict_ldap_get_values[1]: Leaving dict_ldap_get_values postmap: dict_ldap_lookup: Search returned nothing --  	Viktor.
